name: Institute of Tourism Studies
summary: Public tourism and hospitality institute at Aviation Park, Luqa, with a Gozo campus; two English-taught bachelor's open to school-leavers.

ib.text: Entry is worded in MATSEC terms (three Advanced/Intermediate passes incl. one Advanced, 44 grade points, English and Maths). The IB is not named; ITS advises an MQRIC equivalency report and B2 English.

apply.via: ITS online application (Apply Now on each course page)

programmes.name: International Hospitality Management (Hons) with Specialisations
programmes.about: Hotel operations, marketing, accounting and digital technology, with placements and a semester at Haaga-Helia in Finland; in the final year you choose finance, human resources, spa and wellness, or food and beverage and events.
programmes.ib: Entry is in MATSEC terms; ask ITS how your IB results convert.
programmes.selectionNote: Admitted on qualifications: three Advanced/Intermediate passes (one Advanced), 44 grade points, English and Maths at Level 3, or an ITS diploma. Ask about IB.

programmes.name: Diving Safety Management (Full-Time)
programmes.about: Diving science, medical aspects of diving, occupational health and safety, law and emergency response, with certified dive courses, placements and a dissertation; run with DAN Europe and delivered in a blended format.
programmes.ib: You also need an EN Level 2 diving certificate (e.g. PADI Rescue Diver), 30 logged dives, and a diver medical questionnaire; proof can follow by the end of semester one.
programmes.selectionNote: Admitted on qualifications: three Advanced/Intermediate passes (one Advanced), 44 grade points, English and Maths at Level 3, or an ITS diploma. Ask about IB.

notes: ITS's Bachelor in Culinary Arts (Honours) is left out: the direct route needs four years of documented industrial-kitchen experience, otherwise an ITS diploma or preparatory year comes first.
The Diving Safety Management page lists EU/EEA students without a Maltese ID or residence permit at €3,938 a semester for online study only, so ask ITS about an on-campus place before applying.
Applications carry a non-refundable €25 registration fee for Maltese and EU nationals; the course pages show no 2027 closing date, so apply early.
